title: The Vanishing Half
author: Brit Bennett
summary: Twin sisters grow up in a small Black Louisiana town and run away together at sixteen. Years later, one is back with her daughter while the other lives as a white woman, hiding her past, and the book follows both families.
readIf: you like family sagas about identity, belonging and the secrets people keep.
skipIf: you want a fast plot, since this unfolds across decades and many viewpoints.

pairings.reason: Another thoughtful novel about race, identity and who you become when you move between worlds.
A multi-generation family story about outsiders, prejudice and survival.
A softer, warmer story about family, race and belonging in the American South.
